title: How to find the secret UFO in GTA 6 👽
description:
Credit: CohhCarnage (Twitch) https://www.twitch.tv/cohhcarnage/clip/ArtsyGenerousAniseDendiFace-NxwfD1GOBiYOHbfx
There is a real UFO hidden in GTA 6. How to find it:
1. Go to Kelly County, near the Starlet Motel just outside Port Gellhorn.
2. Wait until after 2 AM (in-game time).
3. Find a parked car with flashing lights and its doors open.
4. Follow its headlights into the woods toward the light.
5. Help the stranger and bring their car back to unlock The Truth Is Out There.
Then the UFO comes back for you.

Have you found it yet? 👇

Sources: Beebom, GamesFuze (checked 25 Nov 2026). Narration: AI voice.
